target: Make dope-memory fail closed on workspace identity: reject store/ingest operations whose workspace_id does not match the configured workspace identity, add a supervised quarantine/purge tool for existing cross-repo rows, and cover both with tests - fixing the active contamination class found 2026-07-17 (dNh_CRM sidecar ledger accepting workspace_id=/Users/hue/code/dopemux-mvp rows).
invariants: One public MCP endpoint; no backend ports exposed; no backend writes; no lifecycle mutations from the facade.
target_id is the only caller-facing handle; callers never supply paths, URLs, ports, workspace IDs, or runtime selectors.
Runtime discovery never grants exposure; port leases never prove ownership; heuristics may discover but never authorize; ambiguity blocks; cross-repo mounts block.
A skipped live gate is NOT a pass (ACCEPTANCE_MATRIX.md proof rule); never rewrite a historical PARTIAL/SKIPPED verdict - append new evidence.
Proof must be current to the exact head SHA (scripts/audit/exact_head_readiness.py contract).
STOP IF: the embedded auditor returns FAIL or NEEDS_SUPERVISOR.
Fail-closed: a store whose workspace_id mismatches the configured identity is REJECTED with a structured error (never silently accepted or silently rewritten).
The purge tool is dry-run by default, requires an explicit --apply flag, quarantines rows (export before delete), and never touches rows matching the configured workspace.
Chronicle remains append-only for normal operation; quarantine is an explicit supervised maintenance path, logged with a receipt.
STOP IF: guard cannot be added without breaking legitimate single-workspace writers (inspect all writer paths first).

pr.title: fix(dope-memory): fail-closed workspace identity guard + supervised purge tool
pr.body:
Reject cross-workspace stores at the dope-memory boundary (fail-closed on workspace_id mismatch), ship a dry-run-default quarantine/purge tool for existing cross-repo rows, and test both. Root cause + evidence: Gate-0C snapshot 2026-07-17 (mvp rows written into the dNh_CRM sidecar ledger; mvp stack container running with leaked dNh_CRM identity).

Required PR sections: Objective, Scope, Evidence, Validation, Embedded audit, Risks and unknowns, Rollback, Proof bundle links

steps.task: Inspect dope-memory's store/ingest writer paths and identity configuration (DOPEMUX_WORKSPACE_ID / DOPE_MEMORY_WORKSPACE_ID / mounts) FIRST; then TDD the guard: reject mismatched workspace_id with a structured error + metric, config-gated for one release if needed (default ON). Add the quarantine tool (dry-run default, --apply required, export-quarantined-rows receipt). Document the ops runbook for purge.
requirements: Guard covers every external store/ingest path (enumerate them in the proof).
Structured rejection error names both the configured and offending workspace ids (values are local-only; never exposed through the DCP facade).
Quarantine tool: dry-run default, --apply flag, export-before-delete, receipt file.
Runbook: how to purge the dNh_CRM ledger contamination and re-verify.
validation: No files outside commit.allowlist are modified; change matches the stated scope.

steps.task: Run the packet validation commands and inspect the diff/evidence.
validation: Mismatched-workspace store is rejected in tests; matching store passes.
Purge dry-run reports the contaminated rows without deleting; --apply quarantines with export receipt.

steps.task: Produce the proof bundle under proof/TP-DCP-MCP-RO-0021/ (PROOF.json, COMMAND_LOG.md, AUDITOR_REPORT.md) with embedded_audit conforming to schemas/proof/embedded_audit.schema.json, and record PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN buckets honestly (NOT_RUN never collapsed into PASS).
requirements: COMMAND_LOG.md with outputs and exit codes.
validation: python3 scripts/audit/validate_audit_proof.py passes on the new PROOF.json.
Embedded audit verdict recorded (PASS or PASS_WITH_RISKS with non-blocking risks).
